fact: The UNECA Digital Trade Regulatory Integration profile states Eritrea does not require local data storage and has no infrastructure-related requirements; no date is given for the stated position, so the document's published date (2022-01-01) is used.
Eritrea's ASYCUDA World customs system, developed with UNDP, came with a complete transfer of source code to the Eritrean government, per Shabait (Ministry of Information).
